svg.title: Agent trace fidelity: six levels from minimal to complete
svg.desc: Each row shows one user-to-answer turn at a different display level. Level 1 keeps user prompts and answers. Level 2 adds clipped tool outputs, represented by head and tail fragments with the middle omitted. Level 3 adds tool calls alongside those clipped outputs. Level 4 keeps full tool outputs. Level 5 adds recorded thinking. Level 6 adds the system prompt once at the start of the trace. Tool call and response pairs occur zero to N times per turn. An outer dashed box marks 1 to N user-to-answer turns, excluding the system prompt. Hidden events can still have occurred.

g.text: One trace. Six levels of detail.
Progressively reveal what the trace contains — from conversation only to the complete recorded trace.
Tool activity is omitted from this view.
The underlying turn may still contain 0–N calls.
1–N TURNS PER TRACE · 0–N TOOL CALL / RESPONSE PAIRS PER TURN
N → use one or more tools before answering
Outer box: repeat the turn 1–N times. Inner box: optional tool activity. System prompt: once, outside the turn.
